title: s4w6's modpack
description: My main modpack for Fabric 1.21.1. Mostly QoL, no big fancy unnatural mods :)
body:
A big chunky modpack with a LOT of projects, mostly QoL mods, so no flying mobs and fancy stuff, but still pretty cool additions, like better generation, more immersive feeling, etc etc :)
# Main features:
- Creative enhancements (Axiom, schematics)
- Smoother autojump
- Elytra slot
- Better elytra controls
- Transport villagers in buckets
- Better sounds
- Better Nether generation
- Better 3D textures
- Chat heads and ability to see what a player is doing when AFK/in menus
- Better world organisation (folders, favourites)
- Item physics
- Vertical slabs
- Better enchantment organisation (descriptions, custom book textures, coloured names)
- Better inventory management (sorting, quick refill...)
- Better zoom management
- Better overall immersion
- And much much more, feel free to have a look at the mod list
